reason: Issue #331 본문이 비어 있어 바로 구현할 수 없습니다. 사용자와 grill-me로 설계를 정하거나, 사용자에게 확인받아 Issue 본문을 먼저 채워 주세요.

prompt:
알림 사본은 추측하지 말고 아래 내용으로 `Infra/monitoring/grafana/alerts/service-alerts.yaml` 파일 전체를 교체해줘.
- 이 내용은 Grafana 변경 기록을 기준으로 이미 작성·검증한 것이다.
- `# verify` 주석은 그대로 둔다.
- 교체 후 YAML 문법 검사를 하고, Alloy 변경과 같은 PR에 포함한다.
- PR 본문에 "`# verify` 표시 줄은 Grafana export와 대조가 필요함"을 적는다.

```yaml
apiVersion: 1

# Reference copy of the Bibbidi alert rules. The rules that actually run are
# the ones registered in the Grafana Cloud UI; this file documents them and is
# not imported by any pipeline, so the two can drift apart.
#
# Datasource UIDs are the ones provisioned by Grafana Cloud on this stack:
#   grafanacloud-prom    - grafanacloud-rubyplatypus371-prom   (metrics)
#   grafanacloud-logs    - grafanacloud-rubyplatypus371-logs   (logs)
#   grafanacloud-traces  - grafanacloud-rubyplatypus371-traces (traces, used by
#                          dashboards and log-to-trace links, not by alert rules)
# Do not point rules at grafanacloud-usage, -usage-insights, or
# -alert-state-history: those describe Grafana Cloud itself, not this service.
#
# Last synced with Grafana Cloud: 2026-09-30
#   - Every rule watches production only (deployment_environment_name).
#     bibbidi-instance-down is written in its target state; see its comment.
#   - Lines marked "verify" were written from the change log, not from a Grafana
#     export. Compare them with the live rule when you next export.
groups:
  - orgId: 1
    name: bibbidi-service-symptoms
    folder: Bibbidi/Alerts
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - uid: bibbidi-5xx-rate-warning
        title: Bibbidi API 5xx rate is elevated
        condition: C
        for: 5m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "5xx response ratio is above 5%"
          description: "At least 5% of Backend HTTP responses have a 5xx status for 5 minutes. Check the Service Overview dashboard and Loki logs."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
          panel_id: "3"
        labels: {severity: warning, service: bibbidi, symptom: api-errors}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-normal-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5..", deployment_environment_name="production"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name="production"}[5m])), 1)'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [0.05], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-5xx-rate-critical
        title: Bibbidi API 5xx rate is critical
        condition: C
        for: 2m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "5xx response ratio is above 15%"
          description: "At least 15% of Backend HTTP responses have a 5xx status for 2 minutes. Treat this as an active API outage."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
          panel_id: "3"
        labels: {severity: critical, service: bibbidi, symptom: api-errors}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-severity-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5..", deployment_environment_name="production"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{deployment_environment_name="production"}[5m])), 1)'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [0.15], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-api-latency-p95
        title: Bibbidi API p95 latency is high
        condition: C
        for: 10m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "API p95 latency is above 1 second"
          description: "The 5-minute p95 latency is above 1 second. Check Database Pool, JVM, and Trace views for the slow dependency."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
          panel_id: "5"
        labels: {severity: warning, service: bibbidi, symptom: latency}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-normal-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 600, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{deployment_environment_name="production"}[5m])))'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [1], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

  - orgId: 1
    name: bibbidi-runtime-symptoms
    folder: Bibbidi/Alerts
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - uid: bibbidi-hikari-pending-warning
        title: Bibbidi Hikari pending connections persist
        condition: C
        for: 5m
        noDataState: NoData
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "HikariCP has pending connection requests"
          description: "One or more callers have waited for a database connection for 5 minutes. Check database health and active connection usage."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
          panel_id: "12"
        labels: {severity: warning, service: bibbidi, symptom: database-pool}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-normal-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'max(hikaricp_connections_pending{deployment_environment_name="production"})'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [0], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: max}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-hikari-pending-critical
        title: Bibbidi Hikari pool is saturated
        condition: C
        for: 2m
        noDataState: NoData
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "HikariCP has more than 5 pending connection requests"
          description: "Database pool saturation can cause API timeouts. Check DB availability before increasing the pool size."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
          panel_id: "12"
        labels: {severity: critical, service: bibbidi, symptom: database-pool}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-severity-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'max(hikaricp_connections_pending{deployment_environment_name="production"})'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [5], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: max}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-jvm-heap-warning
        title: Bibbidi JVM heap usage is high
        condition: C
        for: 10m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "JVM heap usage is above 85%"
          description: "High heap usage persisted for 10 minutes. Check GC pause time, allocation rate, and recent deployment changes."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
          panel_id: "7"
        labels: {severity: warning, service: bibbidi, symptom: jvm-memory}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-normal-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 600, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap", deployment_environment_name="production"}) / clamp_min(sum(jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap", deployment_environment_name="production"}), 1)'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [0.85], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      # Target state. Change the live rule only after production `up` carries
      # deployment_environment_name (Alloy scrape target label). noDataState is
      # Alerting, so switching the query earlier fires a false critical alert.
      - uid: bibbidi-instance-down
        title: Bibbidi Backend scrape target is down
        condition: C
        for: 2m
        noDataState: Alerting
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "Prometheus cannot scrape the Bibbidi Backend"
          description: "The Backend target is down or unreachable. Check the backend and Alloy containers, Docker Network, and Actuator access policy."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
        labels: {severity: critical, service: bibbidi, symptom: target-down}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-severity-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 120, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'min(up{job=~".*bibbidi.*", deployment_environment_name="production"})'
              instant: true
              refId: A
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [0], type: lte}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [A]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

  - orgId: 1
    name: bibbidi-log-symptoms
    folder: Bibbidi/Alerts
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Metrics only say that requests failed. These rules watch the log stream
      # itself, so an exception storm that never reaches a 5xx response - a
      # failing scheduled job, a swallowed error - still raises an alert.
      #
      # Labels come from Alloy: job="bibbidi" is set by loki.source.docker, and
      # deployment_environment_name by discovery.relabel.docker_logs.
      # The error rule uses detected_level (set by Grafana Cloud from the log line)
      # because severity_text only carries info/warn: Spring's ECS logs write the
      # level to log.level, which stage.labels does not read.
      - uid: bibbidi-error-log-spike
        title: Bibbidi error log volume is elevated
        condition: C
        for: 5m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "More than 10 ERROR or FATAL log lines in 5 minutes"
          description: "The backend is logging errors at an unusual rate. Open Loki with {job=\"bibbidi\", deployment_environment_name=\"production\"} | detected_level=~\"(?i)error|fatal\" and follow the traceId in the structured metadata into Tempo."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
        labels: {severity: warning, service: bibbidi, symptom: error-logs}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-normal-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              # verify: detected_level filter syntax
              expr: 'sum(count_over_time({job="bibbidi", deployment_environment_name="production"} | detected_level=~"(?i)error|fatal" [5m]))'
              queryType: range
              refId: A
          - refId: B
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: reduce
              reducer: last
              refId: B
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: B
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [10], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [B]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-nginx-5xx-log-spike
        title: Nginx is returning 5xx responses
        condition: C
        for: 5m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "More than 10 nginx 5xx access log lines in 5 minutes"
          description: "Nginx itself is answering 5xx. A 502 or 504 here usually means the backend container is down, restarting, or slower than the 30s proxy_read_timeout - the application metrics may show nothing at all."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
        labels: {severity: critical, service: bibbidi, symptom: gateway-errors}
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-severity-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              expr: 'sum(count_over_time({job="bibbidi", compose_service="nginx", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | http_response_status_code >= 500 [5m]))'
              queryType: range
              refId: A
          - refId: B
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: reduce
              reducer: last
              refId: B
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: B
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [10], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [B]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-auth-5xx-critical
        title: Login/session API is failing
        condition: C
        for: 2m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "More than 5 5xx responses on /api/auth in 5 minutes"
          description: "Login or session renewal is failing in production. Check the Kakao/Google OAuth responses, JWT and session settings, and the refresh_sessions table."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
        labels: {severity: critical, service: bibbidi, symptom: auth-errors}  # verify: symptom
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-severity-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              # verify: query text
              expr: 'sum(count_over_time({job="bibbidi", compose_service="nginx", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | url_path=~"/api/auth/.*" | http_response_status_code >= 500 [5m]))'
              queryType: range
              refId: A
          - refId: B
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: reduce
              reducer: last
              refId: B
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: B
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [5], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [B]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C

      - uid: bibbidi-checklist-5xx-critical
        title: Checklist API is failing
        condition: C
        for: 2m
        noDataState: OK
        execErrState: Error
        annotations:
          summary: "More than 5 5xx responses on /api/checklists in 5 minutes"
          description: "The checklist API is failing in production. Open the error logs, follow the traceId into Tempo, and check database health."
          dashboard_uid: bibbidi-observability
        labels: {severity: critical, service: bibbidi, symptom: checklist-errors}  # verify: symptom
        notification_settings: {receiver: discord-severity-error}
        data:
          - refId: A
            relativeTimeRange: {from: 300, to: 0}
            model:
              # verify: query text
              expr: 'sum(count_over_time({job="bibbidi", compose_service="nginx", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | url_path=~"/api/checklists/.*" | http_response_status_code >= 500 [5m]))'
              queryType: range
              refId: A
          - refId: B
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: A
              type: reduce
              reducer: last
              refId: B
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model:
              expression: B
              type: threshold
              conditions: [{evaluator: {params: [5], type: gt}, operator: {type: and}, query: {params: [B]}, reducer: {params: [], type: last}, type: query}]
              refId: C
```

explanation: Infra/monitoring/alloy/config.alloy에서 up 지표에 배포 환경 라벨을 추가하고 에러 트레이스는 100%, 나머지는 10% 보존하는 tail sampling 경로를 구성했다. Infra/monitoring/grafana/alerts/service-alerts.yaml은 제공된 검증 내용대로 운영 환경 필터, 수신자, 신규 critical 규칙 2개를 반영해 11개 규칙으로 동기화하고 verify 주석을 유지했다. YAML 문법 검사는 통과했고 Alloy 검사는 로컬 Docker 엔진이 실행되지 않아 수행하지 못해 PR 본문에 알린다.
